pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by HandTevy.

pl1: Narcotic OD: Naloxone IN, only if respirations are depressed
Provide patient and/or acquaintance a Naloxone Rescue Kit if available
Narcotic OD: Naloxone if respirations are depressed
Monitoring and interpretation of ECG & EtCO
pl2: Calcium Channel / Beta Blocker OD: Calcium Chloride, Epinephrine Infusion & Glucagon (Beta blocker OD only)
Tricyclic or Phenobarbital OD: Sodium Bicarbonate
